question: Which customer state has the highest average review score? Show state and score.
generated_sql:
SELECT 
    c.customer_state AS state,
    AVG(r.review_score) AS score
FROM customers c
JOIN orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
JOIN order_reviews r ON o.order_id = r.order_id
GROUP BY c.customer_state
ORDER BY score DESC
LIMIT 1

JOIN 
    products AS t4 ON t3.product_id = t4.product_id
